newsitem.title: VIETNAM: Vietnam sells 70 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.9 pct.
newsitem.headline: Vietnam sells 70 bln dong T-notes, rate 11.9 pct.

text.p: Vietnam sold 70 billion dong ($6.005 million) worth of one-year Treasury notes with an annual coupon of 11.9 percent to domestic institutions at an auction on Wednesday, an official at the State Bank of Vietnam said.
At the last auction of government paper, on May 28, the central bank sold 50 billion dong worth of one-year notes at a rate of 12.0 percent.
The issue date of the notes sold on Wednesday is June 6 and maturity will be on June 6, 1998.
The bank said allotments of stock, in dong, were as follows:
Industrial and Commercial Bank of Vietnam 43.7 billion
Bank for Foreign Trade of Vietnam (Vietcombank) 16.3 billion
Vietnam General Insurance Corporation (Bao Viet) 10.0 billion
